clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Trade District, Elling Trias runs a cheese shop with his family. He welcomes customers with easy talk, while his quiet work as an information broker reaches across continents.

Elling Trias sells fine cheese in the Trade District, working beside his wife Elaine and son Ben. He cheerfully offers wheels of cheese and chats with the townsfolk. To those who know better, Trias' Cheese is one of Stormwind's most reliable fronts. The city's steady trade gives operatives, courtiers and adventurers a place to exchange quiet words beyond the city watch's notice.

Elling Trias has informants and allies far beyond what most shopkeepers can claim. He keeps ties with Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7, works with Church contacts such as Bishop DeLavey, and corresponds with agents in Darkshire, Theramore Isle and the distant Plaguelands near Hearthglen. When rumors surface about highway bandits or quiet movements in the countryside, Trias often pieces them together before the royal court takes notice.
